hero.eyebrow: Home of the humbly hand-rolled artisan bagel
hero.title: Hand-rolled. Boiled. *Baked.*
hero.lede: Artisan bagels made just like they're supposed to be, plus breads, pastries and other delights, all baked in house on Pine Log Road.

facts.label: Built from scratch, like everything we bake

items.title: Hand-rolled
items.text: Every bagel is shaped by hand.

items.title: Boiled
items.text: A traditional water boil, what many say makes a real bagel.

items.title: Baked
items.text: Baked in house, along with breads and pastries.

items.a: We use a traditional water-boiled method. The recipe was developed using several New York-style recipes as guides, but it is our own.

items.q: Do you get your water from New York?
items.a: No. A great bagel starts with love and then requires a lot of patience. We give the dough the time it needs to develop its full flavor.

items.q: Do you use preservatives or additives?
items.a: No. Nothing is added to make our bagels last longer or rise faster, including vital wheat gluten. We also offer gluten-friendly products.

sections.title: New flavors week to week.
sections.text: Ask what's in the case today.
